cards.table-harbor-dawn: a wide painted city tabletop seen from above: a harbour at dawn with wooden piers, small boats and coloured containers, soft pink-gold light, lots of calm empty space in the middle for a game board, no text, letters or numbers
cards.table-spire-night: a wide painted rooftop terrace at night seen from above with the glittering city far below, gold crown-shaped inlay on the floor, deep blue and gold, calm empty space in the middle, no text, letters or numbers
cards.table-portal-suburbs: a wide painted quiet suburban street at night seen from above with a swirling purple portal glow on the road, lamp posts and parked cars at the edges, calm empty space in the middle, no text, letters or numbers

style: Bold hand-painted gouache illustration for a cheerful giant-monster city-brawl dice game, thick dark ink outline, saturated neon-night city colours, playful and a little menacing but never gory, simple readable silhouette, centred, no text
notes: Painted variety. Ratio and size are in meta; paint at 1024 px or larger on the long side, we crop and convert. Tables and boards: calm empty middle for the game. Style block: the one in "style". Items with meta.bg set are cut-outs on a flat chroma colour for cutout.py.
